ns2:course.label: Rudiments of Music Theory II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of MUS 103. Includes study of modulation, chromatic harmony, formal structures, and an introduction to twentieth-century composition. Credit toward a degree may be received for MUS 104 or MUS 102, but not for both. Prerequisite: MUS 103 or placement by examination; non-music majors only.
